tagging_policy.content: E-commerce Tagging Policy v3.2 (effective 2026-01-01). Eligibility: only buyers with order status 'fulfilled' are eligible for audience sync; 'refunded', 'cancelled', and $0.00 orders are excluded. Tagging rules: order total >= $250 -> tag 'VIP'; $100-$249.99 -> tag 'Engaged'; under $100 -> tag 'New-Buyer'. All synced buyers also receive the base tag 'Recent-Buyer-2026Q1'. Do not re-add buyers who already exist in the Main Audience; instead note them as 'already present' in any plan.

automation_runbook.content: Mailchimp Sync Runbook. Standard flow: (1) extract fulfilled orders, (2) classify tags per policy, (3) dedupe against Main Audience, (4) produce sync plan for ops lead review, (5) on approval, add subscribers and apply tags, (6) post summary to #ecommerce-ops. Steps 5-6 require explicit ops-lead sign-off before execution.
